model.density_note: Constant-density acoustic baseline consistent with the form of Eq.(1); rho=1000 kg/m^3 is the chosen constant, not a steel/water density model.
model.geometry_assumption: Based on Lu Fig.5: the 56-pixel support is 11.2 mm wide on the 0.2 mm label grid; nonzero glyph is smaller; resize-before-padding is an implementation assumption, not a published recipe.
model.orientation: Transpose raw row-major IDX exactly once; reuse verified upright W from preparation.

grid.boundary: absorbing on all four sides; no free surface or backwall
grid.deviation_from_paper: Paper specifies lateral PML only and does not define top/bottom. This baseline uses external 20-cell PML on all four sides and excludes backwall/free-surface reflection. A future backwall variant is deferred.
grid.coordinate_convention: Physical half-open domain [0,40) mm on each axis; node 1 is 0 mm, node 201 is 20 mm. Array centered at nominal domain center 20 mm. Matrix axes are [depth,lateral].

source.time_zero_definition: t=0 is acquisition/sequence start. Ricker analytic peak delayed by 3/f0=1.333333333333333 us; no trace shifting. Store sampled peak time separately. Future measured data need calibrated trigger and transducer delays; not automatically aligned.

time.resampling: integer stride 8; identical output time origin

benchmark.notes: Same six transmitters once per concurrency level; preliminary throughput, no statistical confidence interval. GPU initialization and a small FFT precede the ready barrier.
